gloss: to get deeply involved in conversation; to talk at length

definitions.gloss: to get deeply absorbed in conversation; to talk at length
definitions.explanation: To become so engrossed in talking with someone that one loses track of time or forgets other obligations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{話|はな}し{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I got into a long conversation with my friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{話|はな}し{込|こ}んで⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The two of them were deep in conversation at the café.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{話|はな}し{込|こ}んでしまって、⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れた→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: I got so caught up talking on the phone that I was late for my appointment.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧ (to talk) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into, deeply). The ～⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of becoming deeply absorbed or immersed in the action. Often implies that the conversation went on longer than intended.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{話|はな}し{込|こ}む: to get into a long chat with a friend
- ⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{話|はな}し{込|こ}む: to get absorbed in a phone conversation
- つい{話|はな}し{込|こ}む: to end up talking at length (unintentionally)
- {夜遅|よるおそ}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{話|はな}し{込|こ}む: to talk late into the night

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{語|かた}り{合|あ}う→語り合う：03045_katariau⟧: to talk together — emphasizes mutual sharing, often of serious or heartfelt topics
- ⟦{長話|ながばなし}→長話：16356_nagabanashi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a long talk — focuses on duration rather than absorption
- ⟦{雑談|ざつだん}→雑談：06639_zatsudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to chat — casual conversation without the nuance of being absorbed
